=== 59475 ORAL ARG DNT ADD LTR.docx ===

TO:		All Parties of Record

FROM:		Commission Advising

RE:	Docket No. 59475 – Joint Application of Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Service Corporation to Amend Their Certificates of Convenience and Necessity for the Bell County East Switch to the Big Hill Substation 765-KV Transmission Line Project in Bell, Burnet, Concho, Coryell, Lampasas, Llano, Mason, McCulloch, Menard, Milam, Mills, San Saba, Schleicher, Tom Green, and Williamson County

DATE:		June 16, 2026


The Commission will not hear oral arguments in the above referenced matter during the open meeting scheduled to begin at 9:30 a.m. on June 18, 2026.  However, interested persons may file any comments regarding this matter in the Commissions Interchange under Docket No. 59475

Please note that before the open meeting begins, members of the public may sign up to speak at the open meeting on any matters on the open-meeting agenda that are not contested cases.  Persons should not sign up to make public comments at the open meeting regarding this matter because it is a contested case.
